run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock classes from specified C++ class names in a header file
generate_all_mocks: generate mock classes for all C++ classes found in a header file
render_cpp_types: render recursively templated C++ types including modifiers, pointers, and references into strings
parse_and_mock: parse a C++ source file AST and generate MOCK_METHOD macros for virtual functions
